title: Asset Library (Libraries)

scenarios.title: Asset Library applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Asset Library (BtnAssetManager) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Asset library containment guard and folder-name sanitization pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The production guards pin: the containment rule that gates every write/delete accepts the asset root itself and its children (trailing separators irrelevant, case-insensitive) but rejects siblings that merely share the root prefix (C:\Root2 vs C:\Root), their children, unrelated ancestors, and blank/null input; the folder-name sanitization removes invalid filename characters, trims and underscores spaces, falls back to 'unnamed' for empty or blank results and caps names at 100 characters. LocalAssetService delegates both guards (CreateFolder/CreateSubFolder/DeleteAsset are gated by the containment rule).
